description: Set down two shillings and eightpence, and the jug, and ended the louder half.
name: Alice Brambleby

description: Brought the grievance, stole the salt-fish, and admired a bill he had not got.
name: Thomas Nashe

description: Replaced the tallow with a fish, and contested the theft.
name: Will Kemp

description: Spoke to keep the fish in play, and would not divide the bill.
name: William Shakespeare
